## CEP onboarding

This repo uses the Context Engineering Protocol (CEP). Before starting work,
read `AGENTS.md` at the repo root — it's the canonical, generated index of
what CEP content already exists in this repo (requirements, architecture and
conventions, compiled guidelines, context packages, decision ledger) and
where each piece lives. This block is only a pointer; the real index lives
in `AGENTS.md`, not here.
